question: 이 중 손이 아닌 것을 모두 고르시오

items.label: 손바닥을 편 손
items.prompt: An open adult human right hand, palm facing the camera, fingers relaxed and slightly spread, wrist at the bottom edge.

items.label: 주먹
items.prompt: A clenched adult human fist seen from the front, knuckles toward the camera, wrist at the bottom edge.

items.label: 노인의 손
items.prompt: An elderly person's open hand, palm facing the camera, deep wrinkles, prominent veins and age spots, wrist at the bottom edge.

items.label: 핏줄이 덮은 손
items.prompt: An open human hand, palm facing the camera, but the skin is almost entirely covered by a dense web of dark red veins and thin root-like vessels branching out from the palm lines across the fingers, slightly translucent skin, unsettling medical look.

items.label: 손가락 여섯 개
items.prompt: An open human hand, palm facing the camera, that has exactly six fingers: five fingers plus one extra finger between the ring finger and the little finger, all realistic skin, otherwise ordinary.

items.label: X선 손
items.prompt: A medical X-ray radiograph of a human hand, palm flat, bones glowing white against black, soft grey outline of flesh visible.

items.label: 다섯 갈래 나뭇가지
items.prompt: A dry bare tree branch that splits into five finger-like twigs so that it resembles an open hand, bark texture, held upright.

items.label: 불가사리
items.prompt: A single beige starfish with five arms standing upright on its tips so its silhouette resembles a spread hand.

items.label: 손 그림자
items.prompt: Only the shadow of an open hand cast on a very dark charcoal wall lit by one dim spotlight, the shadow a deeper black, the hand itself outside the frame and not visible, the wall fading into pure black at the edges so the frame matches a black background.
